title: Every filter or search change re-queries the server and returns the first page of the new result set
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4).
preconditions: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded and the browser devtools network tab open.
steps: 1. Change each of these in turn and watch the network traffic: Type, date range, Bin, Location, Category, Vendor, and the toolbar search.
2. After a filter change while on a later page, note which page of results is shown.
expected: 1. EACH change (Type, date range, Bin, Location, Category, Vendor, search) triggers a fresh server-side data load.
2. There is no client-side-only narrowing - every filter or search change re-queries the server.
3. Each change returns the FIRST page of the new result set.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite: no designs yet; design-reconciliation later if Figma arrives)
notes: Generic backend-behavior case - no endpoint paths asserted (none exist in the spec); record the observed requests at VIU. Server-side model is the committed build target (2026-07-16) - possible delta vs the current build.
